title: Kodi and Gilly
summary: Carry Gilly across broken pillars on Kodi’s shoulder, then send the little axolotl underwater to lower a drawbridge. Reunite at the Sun Archway to clear each jungle chamber.
summaryZhTW: 讓 Kodi 背著 Gilly 跳過斷裂的石柱，再讓小小的六角恐龍潛入水中，拉動機關放下吊橋。兩位夥伴得在太陽拱門前會合，才能一起走出每一座遺跡。
coverAlt: Gilly, a pink axolotl, rides on Kodi’s head as the backpacked bear explores a sunlit jungle temple.
controls: Use A and D to move, W or Space to jump, and E to release Gilly.

approval.note: Creator requested publication in Possibility Games with the supplied jungle ruins cover.
